result.topic_en: Riemann transforms the hypergeometric differential equation for the P-function given by an Euler-type integral into a normal form for an auxiliary function z by substituting $y = x^{-\lambda/2-1/6}(1-x)^{-\nu/2-1/6}z$ with a change of variable $dx = x^{2/3}(1-x)^{2/3}dt$, and computes the resulting coefficient (an invariant) in terms of $\lambda,\mu,\nu$.
